What helps us answer an Enterprise enquiry

  • Peak concurrent connections and messages per month you expect
  • Which SDKs you will use: JavaScript, Python, Java or C++
  • Whether you need WebRTC media, and roughly how much relay
  • Hosting: our servers, a dedicated deployment, or your own
  • Any security or compliance review you need us to complete

GitHub issues are public. Leave out anything confidential: say in the issue that you would like to talk privately, and we will reply with a private channel.
